description: Industrial-risk and environment (ESG) profile of a French company from the official ICPE register (Géorisques/DGPR): classified facilities with Seveso status (upper/lower tier), authorisation regime, activity state, IED flag and a per-SIREN risk synthesis. A company with no classified facility returns level `aucun`: the clean answer is the signal. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_industrial_risk

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French industrial risk (ICPE)
